title: Half Baked — '10 lessons from the most important founder book since The Lean Startup'
summary: Half Baked — the daily startup-ideas newsletter with ~130K subscribers — publishes a long-form Twitter article distilling ten lessons from Incorruptible, from financial gravity as an impersonal force to the spiritual holding company as the book's most radical idea. Headline framing: 'the most important founder book since The Lean Startup.'
blockquote: The most important thing you'll ever build isn't your product. It isn't your distribution either. It's the structure underneath both, the part most founders never read, let alone design.
